Open the book to just the right angle so the pop-up scenery stands. Lower the lid of a panini press and serve every order inside its golden band. Snap the phone shut like a Venus flytrap when a fly lands, but never on a bee. Turn a vault dial one click every 15 degrees. Stand the top half up as a telescope and find the real stars above you.

• Crease: fold a rubber seal onto an inked sheet
• Hinge Safe: the fold is the dial
• Pour: tip a glass jug and fill every glass to its line

• Mirror: bounce spotlights off a real mirror onto crystals

• Drawbridge: bring the knights home

WHY YOU'LL LIKE IT
• No buttons to learn: open, close and hold the fold

• No ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases, nothing about you leaves your phone
• Plays offline

Superhero armor runner meets giant robot boss duels! In Titan Suit: Hero Clash, you run, dash and punch through robot swarms, catch your flying armor and counter the giant Hex Titan. Every hit is a choice: dive for your armor, or keep smashing the swarm.

SALVAGE CATCH
When a hit knocks a piece off your suit, it flies ahead of you and glows for a few seconds. Steer Nova over it to weld it back on – even if it landed next to a robot squad or a saw wall. Every piece you save also powers up your Megabot.

OVERDRIVE DASH
Every robot you smash charges your Overdrive. When it's full, swipe up: Nova blasts forward, untouchable, and bowls straight through the crowd. Save it for big brutes, nasty obstacles or that piece of armor just out of reach.

COUNTER-PUNCH BOSS DUEL
At the end of each stage your surviving armor welds into the giant Titan Megabot. Tap to punch the Hex Titan – but watch it. When it winds up a swing, hit COUNTER at the right moment to block the blow and land a massive counter-punch. Mashing works. Reading the boss wins faster.

THE HEX SWARM IS HERE
The Hex Swarm is invading the sky-cities. Drag to steer Nova through drones, archers, star throwers and heavy brutes while your Elemental Core fires on its own: plasma bolts, flamethrower, ice shards, chain lightning, ground quakes and tornadoes. Dodge spike drums, saw walls, laser fences and swinging hammers.

Choose your first baby cryptid, raise it by the campfire, and watch it grow up. Then adopt more from your Field guide until all six are part of the family.

Cryptid Pets is a cozy virtual pet game in the spirit of the classic keychain pets. Feed your cryptid, play mini games with it, and tuck it in to sleep under a starry night sky. Each pet gets hungry, bored and sleepy in real time, and the campsite gets messy, even while the app is closed, so check in often.

MEET THE CRYPTIDS
• Mothman, from a starlit meadow near Point Pleasant
• Nessie, splashing on the shore of a moonlit Loch Ness
• Bigfoot, wandering the misty redwoods of Bluff Creek
• The Flatwoods Monster, under a hovering UFO in the West Virginia hills
• Chupacabra, in a Puerto Rican rainforest full of chirping coquí frogs

HOW TO PLAY
• Feed: keep the food meter topped up
• Play: catch glowing fireflies with any cryptid, or play your cryptid's own game:

Tap where you want to hit. Your character swings the bat and sends a ball toward the target. Knock objects off their supports or break fragile targets to clear the level before you run out of balls. The controls are easy to learn; choosing the right place to hit is the real challenge.

FIND THE SHOT THAT TOPPLES THE STACK
Study the arrangement before you swing. Aim at a lower support, tip an awkward stack or send one object into another. A well-placed ball can start a chain reaction and clear several targets at once. Try a different angle when a pile stays standing and discover a more efficient way to finish.

newReleases.name: Clawcade

Clawcade puts a real-feeling claw machine in your pocket. Drop a coin, steer the claw, and watch your prize wobble toward the chute, or slip away at the very last second.

REAL CLAW PHYSICS
Every grab is decided by physics, not a hidden win rate. Prizes tumble, roll and stack, and the grip loosens on the long way back. Nudge a prize closer on one try, then win it on the next.

updates.name: Jelly Busters: Puzzle Game
updates.desc:
Drop into the smoothest skatepark in town with the Jelly Busters crew, a squad of bouncy jellies who live to skate, color shoot, and bust their way through walls of cubes. Every run starts with a simple push on your board, a quick aim, and a clean shot as you send your jelly flying into a glowing, colorful puzzle blast of cubes hiding a secret picture and image below.

Jelly Busters adds a fun, skate-infused twist packed with ASMR pleasure and arcade-style thrills. With every tap, you shoot into stacks of colors, bust the cubes, and slowly keep busting the image underneath until the whole board is clear.

The sound and feel are tuned for maximum satisfying chill. Cubes crumble with soft pops, jellies bounce just right, and the whole game wraps you in a relaxing mood that still demands fast reaction and strategic thinking. It’s the perfect combination: a cube shooter that’s as soothing as it is intense, always very satisfying to clear the image at the end of a run.

But the park has tricks of its own. From the very first levels, you’ll see that this isn’t just mindless tapping. The game develops and gets more challenging and harder as you play, with clever layouts and sneaky blockers that force you to plan ahead. Each new level adds a fresh twist - more cubes, tougher patterns, and smarter obstacles that you’ll have to avoid if you want to keep your blast streak going.
